title: Daskam 6
description: The fourteen worlds and the universe described as the limbs and features of the Virat Purusha.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं चतुर्दशजगन्मयतां गतस्य
पातालमीश तव पादतलं वदन्ति ।
पादोर्ध्वदेशमपि देव रसातलं ते
गुल्फद्वयं खलु महातलमद्भुतात्मन् ॥१॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan took the cosmic form of the fourteen worlds as Viraat Swaroopa : The lower worlds - Paataala loka -is the lower portion of Bhagwan’s feet. Ras atala loka - is the upper portion of Bhagwan’s feet. Mahaatala loka is Bhagwan’s two ankles.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ caturdaśajaganmayatāṃ gatasya
pātālamīśa tava pādatalaṃ vadanti |
pādordhvadeśamapi deva rasātalaṃ te
gulphadvayaṃ khalu mahātalamadbhutātman || 6-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जङ्घे तलातलमथो सुतलं च जानू
किञ्चोरुभागयुगलं वितलातले द्वे ।
क्षोणीतलं जघनमम्बरमङ्ग नाभि-
र्वक्षश्च शक्रनिलयस्तव चक्रपाणे ॥२॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Talaatala loka is Bhagwan’s shins (lower part of leg between knee and ankle). Sutala loka is Bhagwan’s knees. Vitala and Atala lokas are the two thighs. The higher worlds: Bhoomi (earth) is Bhagwan’s hip, Bhuva (sky) is Bhagwan’s navel, Swarga (heaven) is
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jaṅghe talātalamatho sutalaṃ ca jānū
kiñcorubhāgayugalaṃ vitalātale dve |
kṣoṇītalaṃ jaghanamambaramaṅga nābhi-
rvakṣaśca śakranilayastava cakrapāṇe || 6-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ग्रीवा महस्तव मुखं च जनस्तपस्तु
फालं शिरस्तव समस्तमयस्य सत्यम् ।
एवं जगन्मयतनो जगदाश्रितैर-
प्यन्यैर्निबद्धवपुषे भगवन्नमस्ते ॥३॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s body is the whole universe. Maharloka is Bhagwan’s neck. Janaloka is Bhagwan’s face. Tapoloka is Bhagwan’s forehead. Satyaloka is Bhagwan’s head. Of all the other things of which the universe is made, Bhagwan’s body is made up of the fourteen worlds and whatever things constituted this universe.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
grīvā mahastava mukhaṃ ca janastapastu
phālaṃ śirastava samastamayasya satyam |
evaṃ jaganmayatano jagadāśritaira-
pyanyairnibaddhavapuṣe bhagavan namaste || 6-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रपदमीश्वर विश्वकन्द
छन्दांसि केशव घनास्तव केशपाशाः ।
उल्लासिचिल्लियुगलं द्रुहिणस्य गेहं
पक्ष्माणि रात्रिदिवसौ सविता च नेत्रे ॥४॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s Brahmarandhra which is the crown of the head are the Vedas. The clouds are Bhagwan’s beautiful locks of hair. The abode of Brahma are Bhagwan’s two eyebrows. Bhagwan’s eyelashes are the night and the day, and HIS eyes is the Sun.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvadbrahmarandhrapadamīśvara viśvakanda
chandāṃsi keśava ghanāstava keśapāśāḥ |
ullāsicilliyugalaṃ druhiṇasya gehaṃ
pakṣmāṇi rātridivasau savitā ca netre || 6-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
निश्शेषविश्वरचना च कटाक्षमोक्षः
कर्णौ दिशोऽश्वियुगलं तव नासिके द्वे ।
लोभत्रपे च भगवन्नधरोत्तरोष्ठौ
तारागणाश्च दशनाः शमनश्च दंष्ट्रा ॥५॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The whole of the creation is the extension of Bhagwan’s one glance. The different directions are HIS ears. The Ashwini devataas are HIS two nostrils. Greed and modesty are HIS lower lip and the upper lip. The stars are HIS teeth, and Yama (death) is Bhagwan’s molars.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niśśeṣaviśvaracanā ca kaṭākṣamokṣaḥ
karṇau diśo’śviyugalaṃ tava nāsike dve |
lobhatrape ca bhagavannadharottaroṣṭhau
tārāgaṇāśca daśanāḥ śamanaśca daṃṣṭrā || 6-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मायाविलासहसितं श्वसितं समीरो
जिह्वा जलं वचनमीश शकुन्तपङ्क्तिः ।
सिद्धादयः स्वरगणा मुखरन्ध्रमग्नि-
र्देवा भुजाः स्तनयुगं तव धर्मदेवः ॥६॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Maaya is Bhagwan’s charming smile and HIS breath is the wind. Water is HIS tongue. The chirpings of the birds are HIS speech and HIS voice are the Sidhdhaas and divine artists. Fire is Bhagwan’s mouth and the Gods are HIS arms. HIS breasts are the dharma devathas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
māyāvilāsahasitaṃ śvasitaṃ samīro
jihvā jalaṃ vacanamīśa śakuntapaṅktiḥ |
siddhādayaḥ svaragaṇā mukharandhramagni-
rdevā bhujāḥ stanayugaṃ tava dharmadevaḥ || 6-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पृष्ठं त्वधर्म इह देव मनः सुधांशु-
रव्यक्तमेव हृदयाम्बुजमम्बुजाक्ष ।
कुक्षिः समुद्रनिवहा वसनं तु सन्ध्ये
शेफः प्रजापतिरसौ वृषणौ च मित्रः ॥७॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Adharma is Bhagwan’s back and the moon is HIS mind. The unmanifest is Bhagwan’s heart lotus and the oceans are HIS abdomen. The dawn & dusk are HIS garments , Prajaapati is HIS generative organ and Bhagwan’s testicles is Mitran devatha.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pṛṣṭhaṃ tvadharma iha deva manaḥ sudhāṃśu-
ravyaktameva hṛdayāmbujamambujākṣa |
kukṣiḥ samudranivahā vasanaṃ tu sandhye
śephaḥ prajāpatirasau vṛṣaṇau ca mitraḥ || 6-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रोणीस्थलं मृगगणाः पदयोर्नखास्ते
हस्त्युष्ट्रसैन्धवमुखा गमनं तु कालः ।
विप्रादिवर्णभवनं वदनाब्जबाहु-
चारूरुयुग्मचरणं करुणाम्बुधे ते ॥८॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The animal world is Bhagwan’s lower-back and the elephants, camels and horses are the nails of HIS feet. Time is Bhagwan’s movement. The four varnas -Brahmins, Kshatriyaa, Vaishyaa and Sudraas originated from Bhagwan’s lotus face, hands, charming thighs and feet, respectively.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śroṇīsthalaṃ mṛgagaṇāḥ padayornakhāste
hastyuṣṭrasaindhavamukhā gamanaṃ tu kālaḥ |
viprādivarṇabhavanaṃ vadanābjabāhu-
cārūruyugmacaraṇaṃ karuṇāmbudhe te || 6-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
संसारचक्रमयि चक्रधर क्रियास्ते
वीर्यं महासुरगणोऽस्थिकुलानि शैलाः ।
नाड्यः सरित्समुदयस्तरवश्च रोम
जीयादिदं वपुरनिर्वचनीयमीश ॥९॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s activity is the birth and death cycle and the host of Asuras are Bhagwan’s prowess. The mountains are HIS bones, the many rivers are HIS blood vessels and the trees are HIS body hair. Bhattathiri wishes that may this indescribable form always shine in him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
saṃsāracakramayi cakradhara kriyāste
vīryaṃ mahāsuragaṇo’sthi-kulāni śailāḥ |
nāḍyaḥ saritsamudayastaravaśca roma
jīyādidaṃ vapuranirvacanīyamīśa || 6-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ईदृग्जगन्मयवपुस्तव कर्मभाजां
कर्मावसानसमये स्मरणीयमाहुः ।
तस्यान्तरात्मवपुषे विमलात्मने ते
वातालयाधिप नमोऽस्तु निरुन्धि रोगान् ॥१०॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Every human being should remember and meditate upon this cosmic Viraat form of Bhagwan which is of pure Sattva nature, after their nitya karmas and at the time of death, to seek liberation. Bhattathiri offers his prayers and salutations to Lord Guruvayoorappan and requests to cure all his afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
īdṛgjaganmayavapustava karmabhājāṃ
karmāvasānasamaye smaraṇīyamāhuḥ |
tasyāntarātmavapuṣe vimalātmane te
vātālayādhipa namo’stu nirundhi rogān || 6-10 ||
